introduction.p: Quotes are given from a student following a quiz. Fill in the blanks with the appropriate vocabulary terms.

statement.p:
During an algebra quiz you had to
evaluate
simplify
solve equations.

solution.p: Typically if you have an equation, your task is to solve that equation.

statement.p:
The last exercise was easy once you
evaluated
simplified
solved each side.

solution.p: You can simplify the two sides of an equation.

statement.p:
Your answer to #4 was nicer once you
evaluated
simplified
solved it.

One word problem asked you to take a given expression for the height of a ball and
evaluate
simplify
solve it for t=7\text{.}

solution.p: When you have a specific number, you can use that to evaluate an expression with one variable by substituting that number in for the variable.
